blocks.text: More than 1,100 foreign nationals were caught working illegally as delivery riders in South Korea during the first eight months of the year, according to a lawmaker, sparking concerns about potential blind spots in the country’s work permit system for foreigners. Rep. Kim Gi-pyo of the Democratic Party of Korea disclosed data from the Ministry of Justice during a parliamentary audit of the ministry on Thursday. The data shows that 1,132 foreign nationals were caught working as delivery riders without proper authorization between January and August.
